name: Javier Delgado Ruiz
title: Principal UX/UI Designer
summary: Highly accomplished Principal UX/UI Designer with over a decade of experience leading design initiatives and cultivating user-centered product development. Expertise in driving end-to-end design processes from research and ideation to prototyping and implementation. Proven track record of enhancing user satisfaction, increasing engagement, and delivering significant business value through innovative design solutions.

bullets: Led a team of 5 UX/UI designers, guiding design strategy for core delivery features that resulted in a 15% increase in user retention.
Designed and implemented a scalable design system, reducing design-to-development handover time by 20% and ensuring brand consistency across 3 major product lines.
Conducted extensive user research (interviews, usability tests) with over 200 users, informing product roadmap decisions and improving user satisfaction scores by 10 points.
Spearheaded the redesign of the mobile application for EV charging, leading to a 25% increase in session duration and an 18% improvement in charging session completion rates.
Collaborated closely with product managers and engineers to define product requirements and translate complex technical functionalities into intuitive user flows.
Mentored junior designers, fostering a culture of design excellence and contributing to the growth of the design team from 3 to 8 members.
Designed user interfaces and experiences for enterprise software solutions, improving workflow efficiency for internal clients by 10%.
Conducted A/B testing on key features, which led to a 7% conversion rate uplift on critical user journeys.
Developed interactive prototypes and wireframes to present design concepts to stakeholders and gather early feedback.
Assisted in the development of UI components for the company's website and mobile app, ensuring adherence to brand guidelines.
Contributed to user research activities, including competitor analysis and heuristic evaluations.
Supported the senior design team in preparing presentations and design documentation.

education.degree: Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Design Engineering

certifications: Certified Usability Analyst (CUA) - Human Factors International (HFI)
